data.desc: eGain is a leading provider of AI-powered knowledge management and customer experience automation solutions and was named a Leader in the Gartner inaugural Magic Quadrant for Customer Service Knowledge Management Systems. With over 25 years of experience in knowledge management, eGain helps enterprises unify siloed content, automate trusted knowledge workflows, and deliver measurable AI-ROI through proven frameworks and methods. Global 2000 companies across industries rely on eGain to transform customer service, improve employee productivity, reduce costs, and accelerate AI adoption. Visit www.eGain.com for more info.
